wins: Documented the internal segmentation and mapped 3 distinct VLANs via initial ARP sweep and traceroute, highlighting the protected management zone (ep001_step4, ep001_step6).
Captured and analyzed HTTP service banners leading to identification of exposed administrative endpoints and version mismatches (ep001_step9, ep001_step11).
Successfully executed credential harvesting reconnaissance by combining open redirect probes with LDAP query timing to infer valid usernames (ep001_step13).
fails: Repeated exploit payload attempts against the SMB service were blocked by enhanced Windows Defender and modern SMB signing, preventing lateral movement (ep001_step15).
Privilege escalation scripts failed due to missing writable scheduled tasks and lack of overloaded DLLs on the target, halting persistence gains (ep001_step18).
SSH brute force sequences triggered account lockout policies before a valid credential could be obtained, leaving shell access unattained (ep001_step12).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and enumeration efforts successfully mapped critical services and potential weak points, but every lateral movement and escalation attempt was stopped by strong endpoint protections, resulting in no mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated brute-force attempts on SSH resulted in account lockouts before valid credentials were confirmed, wasting time and triggering defensive alerts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner responds without rate limiting
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap scripts to capture supported ciphers and user list hints

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 443 responds with a transparent redirect and non-standard cookies
skill_cards.then_action: Run burp spider and nmap http-enum against admin endpoints, capturing hidden directories for later brute forcing

skill_cards.if_condition: When LDAP port 389 is accessible and response times vary by query
skill_cards.then_action: Issue anonymous LDAP queries and timing attacks to enumerate valid usernames before brute forcing

memory_ops.reason: High success rate during reconnaissance in reliably capturing SSH configuration context
Consistent identification of administrative endpoints that feed later-stage exploitation planning

next_experiments.title: Credential Access via Secondary Service
next_experiments.description: Shift focus to the exposed LDAP service and craft a hybrid timing/brute-force sequence using discovered usernames rather than SSH alone to avoid lockouts.

next_experiments.title: Service Hardening Insight Collection
next_experiments.description: Execute smbclient session enumeration with elevated logging to capture policy settings, then compare to alternate SMB exploitation techniques that bypass signing requirements.

next_experiments.title: Posture-Focused Persistence Probe
next_experiments.description: After gaining limited shell access, deploy local reconnaissance only (no exploitation) to map defensive controls before attempting scheduled-task based persistence to reduce detection risk.
